designRule: Source-derived coverage is mapped into native MasteryOS competencies; external courses remain provenance/alternatives, not runtime dependencies.

conventions.ids: kebab-case; topic ids are globally unique; phase ids are unique within a program; domain ids are unique within a phase
conventions.topicPrerequisites: topic ids from the topics registry; must form an acyclic graph
conventions.depth: foundation | core | advanced | specialist | frontier; a topic placement uses topic.depth when set, otherwise its phase depth
conventions.order: programs, phases, domains and topics are listed in recommended route order
